harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker to run as a systemd service named inventory-worker under a dedicated inventorysvc system account on node1, verified it runs correctly, then performed the mandatory single-node restart protocol and confirmed the service auto-recovered post-reboot.
actions_performed: Inspected node1: RHEL 7.9, systemd, confirmed /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker is a simple sleep-loop shell script, confirmed passwordless sudo
Created dedicated system account inventorysvc (no login shell, no home) via useradd --system
Wrote /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service running ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker as User=inventorysvc/Group=inventorysvc, with NoNewPrivileges
Ran systemctl daemon-reload, enable, and restart on inventory-worker.service
Verified service active/enabled and process owned by inventorysvc
Captured pre-restart boot_id and service health baseline
Issued sudo -n reboot (backgrounded via nohup so ack returned before disconnect)
Polled node1 until exec connectivity returned
Verified post-restart boot_id differs from baseline and service is active/enabled with a new MainPID owned by inventorysvc

evidence.requirement: os-comparison-worker configured as managed service 'inventory-worker' under dedicated 'inventorysvc' account
evidence.summary: Confirmed target binary/OS, then created inventorysvc user and inventory-worker.service; verified active/enabled with process running as inventorysvc (PID 2173)

evidence.requirement: node1 restart evidence: healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Captured baseline boot_id (fe422859-bfe7-4eb4-819b-e09864f3ca60), uptime, and active inventory-worker.service with MainPID=2173

evidence.requirement: node1 restart evidence: restart acknowledgement and disconnection
evidence.summary: Issued backgrounded sudo -n reboot which returned an ack, then confirmed node1 became unreachable (SSH connection timed out), proving the reboot took effect

evidence.requirement: node1 restart evidence: changed boot identity and recovery
evidence.summary: Reconnected once exec became available again; boot_id changed to be48fda2-9c49-4834-8bb9-18f274083cdd (different from baseline) with fresh uptime, and inventory-worker.service was active/enabled again with new MainPID=872 running as inventorysvc, proving service recovery after restart
